dataset: Codex Conditions official renal etiology B29
policy: Fill only currently absent bilingual etiology fields for five renal Conditions or findings. Preserve all existing narrative, safety fields, acupuncture scope, relations, and provenance; append two directly retrievable NIH or NHS sources per record. Distinguish a simple cyst from inherited or acquired cystic disease and a urine finding from its underlying disease.

cond.renal_cyst.etiology_zh: 單純腎囊腫是腎實質內形成的圓形或橢圓形薄壁液體囊，確切起因尚未完全明瞭，隨年齡增加而更常見。可能涉及腎小管局部阻塞、憩室樣擴張或上皮分泌液體，但這些仍是機轉假說，不能寫成已證實的單一原因。單純囊腫通常不改變整體腎形、也不取代正常組織，與遺傳性 polycystic kidney disease（多發、腎臟增大並可有肝囊腫）不同；亦須與既有 CKD／kidney failure 後出現的 acquired cystic kidney disease 分開。影像上的 complex cyst 若有厚壁、分隔、鈣化或 enhancement，不能按單純囊腫處理，需依影像分類排除 cystic neoplasm。年齡與男性性別是流行病學相關因素，但不表示可據此判定個別囊腫來源。
cond.renal_cyst.etiology_en: A simple renal cyst is a round or oval thin-walled fluid-filled sac within the kidney. Its initiating cause is not fully understood, and prevalence increases with age. Local tubular obstruction, diverticular dilation, or epithelial fluid secretion have been proposed, but these remain mechanistic hypotheses rather than one proven cause. A simple cyst usually does not distort the whole kidney or replace normal tissue and is distinct from inherited polycystic kidney disease, which produces numerous cysts, enlarged kidneys, and sometimes liver cysts. It is also distinct from acquired cystic kidney disease that develops after established chronic kidney disease or kidney failure. An imaging-defined complex cyst with thick wall, septa, calcification, or enhancement should not be treated as a simple cyst and requires imaging classification to exclude cystic neoplasm. Older age and male sex are epidemiologic associations, not proof of the origin of an individual cyst.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Simple Kidney Cysts — unknown cause, age association, simple-cyst morphology and distinction from PKD (reviewed 2019-06); NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: Kidney Cysts — simple age-associated cysts versus inherited PKD and CKD-associated acquired cystic disease (updated 2025)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: Simple Kidney Cysts — unknown cause, age association, simple-cyst morphology and distinction from PKD (reviewed 2019-06); NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: Kidney Cysts — simple age-associated cysts versus inherited PKD and CKD-associated acquired cystic disease (updated 2025)

cond.polycystic_kidney_disease.etiology_zh: 多囊腎是遺傳性 cystic kidney disease，而不是多個單純腎囊腫的同義詞。最常見的 autosomal dominant PKD（ADPKD）多由 PKD1 或 PKD2 pathogenic variant 造成，影響 polycystin 相關的腎小管上皮結構與訊號，使少數 tubules 逐漸擴張、分離並形成充液囊腫；其他較少見基因可造成 ADPKD-like phenotype，部分臨床個案現有檢測仍找不到致病變異。多數 ADPKD 由受影響父母遺傳，每名子女各有 50% 機會取得變異，也可由 de novo variant 發生。較少見 autosomal recessive PKD 通常由雙等位 PKHD1 變異造成，常在胎兒或兒童期表現並合併 congenital hepatic fibrosis，不能與成人型混寫。高血壓、鹽分、體重或腎損傷會影響進展，卻不是遺傳性囊腫形成的根本原因。感染、出血與結石是囊腫疾病的併發症，不是 PKD 的初始病因。
cond.polycystic_kidney_disease.etiology_en: Polycystic kidney disease is an inherited cystic disorder, not a synonym for having several simple renal cysts. The common autosomal dominant form (ADPKD) is usually caused by a pathogenic PKD1 or PKD2 variant affecting polycystin-related tubular epithelial structure and signaling, allowing selected tubules to dilate, separate, and form fluid-filled cysts. Less common genes can produce an ADPKD-like phenotype, and current testing does not identify a causal variant in every clinically affected person. Most ADPKD is inherited from an affected parent, giving each child an independent 50% chance of inheriting the variant, but de novo variants also occur. The rarer autosomal recessive form is usually caused by biallelic PKHD1 variants, often presents before birth or in childhood, and is associated with congenital hepatic fibrosis; it should not be merged with adult-onset ADPKD. Hypertension, salt exposure, body weight, and kidney injury can modify progression but are not the root cause of inherited cyst formation. Infection, bleeding, and stones are complications rather than the initiating cause of PKD.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: What Is Polycystic Kidney Disease — genetic cause, dominant versus recessive forms and inherited or de novo variants (reviewed 2017-10); NHS Genomics Education: ADPKD — PKD1/PKD2 and less common genes, dominant inheritance and phenotype variability (reviewed 2026)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: What Is Polycystic Kidney Disease — genetic cause, dominant versus recessive forms and inherited or de novo variants (reviewed 2017-10); NHS Genomics Education: ADPKD — PKD1/PKD2 and less common genes, dominant inheritance and phenotype variability (reviewed 2026)

cond.iga_nephropathy.etiology_zh: IgA 腎病變的確切起始原因尚未完全確定；核心是結構異常、galactose-deficient IgA1 增多，形成針對該 IgA1 的抗體與 circulating immune complexes，沉積於 glomerular mesangium，啟動補體、發炎與後續纖維化。這是多步驟免疫疾病，不是單純「IgA 太多」，也不是細菌或病毒直接感染腎臟。遺傳易感、黏膜免疫與環境暴露共同影響發病；上呼吸道或腸胃感染常與肉眼血尿發作時間相近，較像黏膜免疫 trigger，而非已證實的唯一根本病因。IgA vasculitis 也可有相似腎沉積，但具有全身小血管炎表現，需分開分類；肝病、發炎性腸病或感染相關 secondary IgA deposition 亦應與 primary IgA nephropathy 區別。血尿與蛋白尿提示 glomerular injury，但確立 IgA nephropathy 通常需要 kidney biopsy 顯示 mesangial IgA-dominant deposits。
cond.iga_nephropathy.etiology_en: The initiating cause of IgA nephropathy is not fully resolved. A central model involves increased galactose-deficient IgA1, antibodies directed against that altered IgA1, and circulating immune complexes that deposit in the glomerular mesangium, activate complement and inflammation, and ultimately promote fibrosis. This is a multistep immune disease, not simply “too much IgA,” and not direct bacterial or viral infection of the kidney. Genetic susceptibility, mucosal immune regulation, and environmental exposure interact. Upper-respiratory or gastrointestinal infections often occur close to episodes of visible hematuria and are better treated as mucosal immune triggers than as the one proven root cause. IgA vasculitis can produce similar renal deposits but includes systemic small-vessel vasculitis and should be classified separately. Liver disease, inflammatory bowel disease, or infection-associated secondary IgA deposition also requires distinction from primary IgA nephropathy. Hematuria and proteinuria indicate glomerular injury, but confirmation generally requires kidney biopsy showing IgA-dominant mesangial deposits.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: IgA Nephropathy discovery review — abnormal IgA/IgG complexes, mesangial deposition, inflammation and genetic/mucosal immune model (updated 2014-03-01); NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: IgA nephropathy — IgA deposition, glomerular inflammation, familial association and infection-linked episodes (reviewed 2025-09-02)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: IgA Nephropathy discovery review — abnormal IgA/IgG complexes, mesangial deposition, inflammation and genetic/mucosal immune model (updated 2014-03-01); NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: IgA nephropathy — IgA deposition, glomerular inflammation, familial association and infection-linked episodes (reviewed 2025-09-02)

cond.proteinuria.etiology_zh: 蛋白尿是尿中蛋白超過正常少量的檢驗／臨床徵象，不是單一疾病。Glomerular proteinuria 最常見於 filtration barrier 受損，使 albumin 等較大蛋白漏入尿中，例如 diabetes、hypertension、glomerulonephritis 或 nephrotic disorders。Tubular proteinuria 是近端腎小管無法正常回收已濾過的小分子蛋白，可見於 tubulointerstitial injury 或遺傳性 tubular disease。Overflow proteinuria 則因血中產生過多可濾過蛋白，超過腎小管回收能力，例如 plasma-cell disorder 的 light chains；postrenal proteinuria 可由下泌尿道發炎、感染或出血加入蛋白。發燒、劇烈運動、脫水、急性 illness 或直立姿勢可造成短暫／orthostatic proteinuria，因此單次 dipstick 陽性不能直接診斷 chronic kidney disease。Dipstick 主要偵測 albumin，可能漏掉 light chains，也會受尿液濃度影響；持續性結果應以 urine albumin- or protein-to-creatinine ratio 定量，配合 eGFR、尿沉渣與臨床原因評估。
cond.proteinuria.etiology_en: Proteinuria is a laboratory and clinical finding of more than the normal small amount of urinary protein, not one disease. Glomerular proteinuria occurs when the filtration barrier is damaged and larger proteins such as albumin leak into urine, as in diabetes, hypertension, glomerulonephritis, or nephrotic disorders. Tubular proteinuria reflects failure of proximal tubules to reclaim normally filtered low-molecular-weight proteins and can accompany tubulointerstitial injury or inherited tubular disease. Overflow proteinuria occurs when excessive circulating filterable protein exceeds tubular reabsorptive capacity, such as immunoglobulin light chains in a plasma-cell disorder. Postrenal protein can be added by lower-urinary-tract inflammation, infection, or bleeding. Fever, strenuous exercise, dehydration, acute illness, or upright posture can cause transient or orthostatic proteinuria, so one positive dipstick does not establish chronic kidney disease. Dipsticks mainly detect albumin, may miss light chains, and are affected by urine concentration. Persistent findings should be quantified with an albumin- or protein-to-creatinine ratio and interpreted with eGFR, urine sediment, and evaluation of the underlying cause.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Albuminuria — damaged filtration barrier and albumin leakage as a sign rather than a standalone diagnosis (reviewed 2016-10); NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: Protein in Urine — normal protein retention, kidney-filter damage and persistent proteinuria testing boundary (reviewed 2024)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: Albuminuria — damaged filtration barrier and albumin leakage as a sign rather than a standalone diagnosis (reviewed 2016-10); NIH/NLM MedlinePlus: Protein in Urine — normal protein retention, kidney-filter damage and persistent proteinuria testing boundary (reviewed 2024)

cond.hematuria.etiology_zh: 血尿是尿液中出現 red blood cells 的徵象，可為肉眼可見或僅顯微鏡檢出，並非單一疾病。來源可位於 glomeruli、腎實質、ureter、bladder、prostate 或 urethra；常見原因包括 UTI 或其他發炎、urinary stones、trauma／近期器械處置、BPH、劇烈運動與 glomerular disease，重要但較少見的原因包括 kidney／bladder／prostate cancer、sickle cell disease 或 coagulation disorder。Anticoagulant 使用可能加重出血，但不應自動當成唯一原因而停止尋找 underlying lesion。紅色或棕色尿也可能來自 menstruation contamination、beetroot／藥物色素、hemoglobinuria 或 myoglobinuria，dipstick heme 陽性需配合 microscopy 確認 RBC。Dysmorphic RBC、RBC casts、proteinuria 或腎功能異常較支持 glomerular source；clots 較支持 nonglomerular urinary tract bleeding，但都不是單獨確診。可見血尿即使無痛、量少或只出現一次仍需評估，因 symptom absence 不能排除 malignancy。
cond.hematuria.etiology_en: Hematuria is the finding of red blood cells in urine, either visible or detected microscopically; it is not a single disease. Blood may originate in glomeruli, renal parenchyma, ureter, bladder, prostate, or urethra. Causes include urinary infection or inflammation, stones, trauma or recent instrumentation, benign prostatic enlargement, vigorous exercise, and glomerular disease, while important less common causes include kidney, bladder, or prostate cancer, sickle cell disease, and coagulation disorders. Anticoagulants may increase bleeding but should not automatically be accepted as the sole cause without looking for an underlying lesion. Red or brown urine can also result from menstrual contamination, beetroot or medicine pigment, hemoglobinuria, or myoglobinuria, so dipstick heme requires microscopy to confirm red cells. Dysmorphic red cells, red-cell casts, proteinuria, or impaired kidney function support a glomerular source, whereas clots favor nonglomerular urinary-tract bleeding, but neither pattern alone is definitive. Visible hematuria requires assessment even when painless, scant, or present once because absence of other symptoms does not exclude malignancy.

etiology_zh: NIH/NIDDK: Hematuria — visible/microscopic distinction, urinary and glomerular causes, exercise/trauma/medicine context and confirmation pathway (reviewed 2020-06); NHS: Blood in urine — whole-tract sources, infection/stone/prostate differential, mimics and cancer-exclusion boundary (reviewed 2023-05-19)
etiology_en: NIH/NIDDK: Hematuria — visible/microscopic distinction, urinary and glomerular causes, exercise/trauma/medicine context and confirmation pathway (reviewed 2020-06); NHS: Blood in urine — whole-tract sources, infection/stone/prostate differential, mimics and cancer-exclusion boundary (reviewed 2023-05-19)
